name: claude-browser-bridge
description: Let Claude use your real Firefox: tabs, pages, screenshots, clicks and typing, with your own sign-ins.
long_description:
Claude Browser Bridge connects Claude to the Firefox you already use, so it keeps your sign-ins, VPN and ad blocker.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Install the Firefox add-on: open `claude-browser-bridge-1.0.2.xpi` in Firefox and click **Add**.
2. Get the connection code from Firefox: click the **Claude Browser Bridge** icon in Firefox's toolbar, then **Copy connection code**. If you don't see the icon, open the puzzle-piece Extensions menu in the toolbar first.
3. Paste the code into this extension's **Connection code from Firefox** field and save.
4. The add-on's toolbar badge turns green **ON**. Claude can now use the Firefox tools.

**Safety:** the connection is local only (127.0.0.1) and protected by the code. Typing into password, credit-card and one-time-code fields is refused. The add-on's popup has an on/off switch and a log of every action Claude took.

connection_code.title: Connection code from Firefox
connection_code.description: In Firefox, click the Claude Browser Bridge toolbar icon (look in the puzzle-piece Extensions menu if it's hidden), then click 'Copy connection code' and paste it here. Install the Firefox add-on first.
